resources.string: Lets OwnTV put the TV into standby: from a shortcut with the standby action, or after the screensaver has run for a while. With HDMI-CEC the TV switches off too. OwnTV does not read the screen or anything you do.

Lets OwnTV see which app is open, so its recent apps include apps you opened any way, and lets a layout give remote buttons (red, green, guide and others) another job, also inside other apps. OwnTV sees the buttons you press but only acts on the ones your layout binds. Nothing is stored or sent, apart from when an app was last used.
